about: Mad Mixer <-> MAD bridge: the exact request-signing algorithm, with fixed-input test vectors. MAD implements it in lib/mixer-bridge.js and tests it in tests/integration/mixer-internal.test.js; the Vercel repo (mad-mixer, lib/crypto.js) must reproduce every value below byte for byte. Never put a real secret in this file.
changes: v2 (2026-10-02): the sign-in hand-off (K_handoff, AES-256-GCM handoffs) is gone - owner decision: MAD links to MIXER_URL plainly and listeners sign in on the Mixer. Signing and its vectors are unchanged from v1.

algorithm.secret: MIXER_SHARED_SECRET, surrounding whitespace trimmed, taken as its UTF-8 bytes (not base64-decoded). Same value on Render (MAD) and Vercel.

key.ikm: UTF-8 bytes of the trimmed secret
key.name: K_sign

request_signature.direction: Vercel -> MAD, every call to MAD_INTERNAL_URL/internal/mixer/*

headers.X-MM-Ts: Unix time in whole seconds, decimal string

request_signature.canonical:
ts + "
" + METHOD (upper case) + "
" + path + "
" + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact raw body bytes (empty body for GET -> e3b0c442...b855)
request_signature.path: the request path INCLUDING any query string, exactly as sent, starting /internal/mixer/ (e.g. /internal/mixer/songs)
request_signature.signature: base64url without padding of HMAC-SHA256(K_sign, canonical as UTF-8)
request_signature.verify: MAD rejects |now - ts| > 60 s (401 'skew') and compares signatures in constant time (401 'bad-signature'). The body is hashed from the RAW bytes received, before any JSON parsing; POST bodies are JSON (Content-Type: application/json), at most 16 KB.
